title: Unblock resolved archived external handoff from new Work Item start
outOfScope: Changing archived Contract, Summary, Outcome, or Manifest bytes.
Changing external provider state, PR state, or remote branches.
Changing external handoff validation semantics or allowing unresolved handoffs to be ignored.
Implementing WI-01 performance behavior before this lifecycle defect is closed.

sources.reason: Current ai-start treats resolved archived handoff/receipt records as an active Work Item and blocks the next Work Item.
Regression evidence must prove valid resolved archived handoffs are ignored while unresolved or malformed handoffs still block.
The observed active handoff is paired with a complete immutable archive; this is the required eligibility condition for unblocking.
Observed active handoff record that currently blocks ai-start despite a matching receipt and complete archive.
Observed matching external receipt used to validate the resolved state; receipt bytes remain unchanged.
Documents the resolved archived handoff condition and fail-closed recovery behavior.
Capability source that binds scripts/ai_start.py to the repository governance layer.

riskAssessment.reason: A resolved, archived external handoff must not block new Work Item creation, while unresolved, malformed, unarchived, or mismatched handoffs must remain blocking.

reasons: Lifecycle gate behavior changes affect strict lifecycle governance and require strict verification.

override.reason: The user authorized continuous execution and the minimum corrective lifecycle change.

executionDecision.reason: The observed failure is reproducible, the safe eligibility rule is explicit, and the user authorized the corrective lifecycle work.

preReviewWarnings: Review that only a valid receipt paired with a complete archive is ignored; all other handoff states remain fail-closed.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: ai-start permits a new Work Item when an external handoff has a matching valid receipt and the same Work Item has a complete immutable archive.
ai-start continues to block unresolved, expired, malformed, mismatched, or unarchived handoffs.
Regression tests cover valid resolved, missing receipt, invalid receipt, and missing archive cases without mutating evidence.
The implementation preserves the existing read-only handoff validator and does not claim provider or human completion beyond the receipt.
Troubleshooting documentation describes the exact fail-closed recovery boundary.
guidelines: Keep resolved-handoff eligibility separate from external handoff validation and archive closure.
Do not weaken fail-closed behavior for unresolved or unbound evidence.
Every behavior change has a focused regression test and a negative test.

intent.problem: The repository's ai-start gate treats any active handoff or receipt JSON as an active Work Item, even when the handoff receipt validates and the original Work Item already has a complete immutable archive. This prevents the next Work Item from starting after a legitimate external action has resolved.
constraints: Preserve immutable archive bytes and the exact active handoff and receipt bytes.
Do not treat a receipt as archive, merge, release, or branch-deletion evidence.
Ignore a handoff only when the receipt validates against it and the archived Work Item is complete.
Keep unresolved, expired, malformed, cross-task, and unarchived handoffs fail-closed.
Do not change the 14-WI product scope; this is a necessary lifecycle corrective prerequisite.
intent.rationale: Starting the performance Work Item is impossible while a resolved archived handoff is misclassified as active. A narrowly tested eligibility filter restores the documented lifecycle without weakening evidence validation.

rawUserRequest: Execute the complete 14-WI improvement program continuously. If a lifecycle defect blocks the first WI, correct that defect with the minimum necessary Work Item and executable regression gate, preserving fail-closed behavior and recording the user authorization in the Contract.

declaredIntent.summary: Allow the next governed Work Item to start after a resolved, archived external handoff while preserving fail-closed behavior for every unresolved or unbound state.

humanDecisionPoints: The user authorized continuous execution and corrective lifecycle work; no provider, release, merge, or branch-deletion operation is performed by this corrective implementation.
